chapter: Barnet, 52nd Street and New York recording dates
title: Playing around New York; Boyd Raeburn; leading his own band
summary: After Barnet he played small jobs, a few months with Raeburn, and formed his own band from November 1943.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: And I stayed with him about a year, and then I played around New York, little jobs around New York. But I did play with Boyd Raeburn around New York for a while too.
wasn't that later on or -- according to Chilton, right after you left Barnet, you formed your own band in New York.

I did. I had my own band. He's right. I did have my own band. I went with Raeburn later, and I didn't -- I wasn't with Raeburn over about four months, three or four months, not long, just played two or three jobs with him. But I had my own band going for quite a while after I left -- after I left Barnet.
